Subject: AltWork case study request and rebate proposal

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited about Redwood's latency profile and prefix caching; it's a clear fit for our customer-facing assistant. We're preparing a short customer story and a joint blog/post-demo package.

High level ask from our side: in exchange for a 12-month co-branded case study, a short video testimonial (onsite), and a visibility window for Redwood on our product homepage (2 weeks), we are asking for a one-time rebate applied to our initial three-month committed spend (we proposed a 15% rebate off committed charges).

Attached: AltWork_logo.zip and a one-page mutual-action-plan we drafted. Sam (procurement) is copied for contract coordination.

Would you be able to route this for approval? We are aiming to finalize terms and the mutual action plan by next Wednesday (12/2).

Appreciate it,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Partnerships
AltWork Inc

Team — forwarding conversation from AltWork. Deal: mid-market, expected monthly hosted spend ~$37k, first 3 months committed. External proposes a 15% one-time rebate for the first three months in exchange for: a 12-month case study, a short onsite testimonial video, and a 2-week homepage placement.

What I need:
- Sales: approve rebate fraction vs. current deal desk cap (Ben/Vivek)
- Marketing: confirm the visibility window is acceptable and asset delivery timeline (Marissa)
- Legal: flag any publicity/trademark terms we should require (Jonas)

AltWork wants to close by 12/2. Attaching their MAP.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwood.com

Priya — quick thoughts:
- Standard internal discount band for self-serve hosted is 10% for first-term concessions without exec sign-off. Anything >10% requires VP approval or a written exception.
- 15% one-time rebate on 3 months at $37k/mo equates to ~ $16.65k in net concessions — sounds material but not outside the realm for a strategic reference customer.
- Need clarity on whether rebate is refundable (applied retroactively) or delivered as credit. Prefer credit against invoices to avoid revenue recognition complexities.

If marketing commits to the case study and a specific asset/event timeline, and legal confirms ordinary publicity language, I'm ok escalating to Vivek for an exec sign-off.

Ben Carter
Director, Deal Desk | Redwood Inference

- Asset delivery schedule: logo + 1-2 customer quotes by 12/10, placeholder video outline by 12/15, final video by 1/15.
- Ask that AltWork provides an org-wide release approval (someone from legal/brand) rather than a single PM.

If those timelines are acceptable, marketing will commit to homepage placement and coordinated social posts during the 2-week window. Attached: redwood-marketing-guidelines.pdf (branding do's/don'ts).

All — after reviewing the numbers and the marketing ask, I will approve a one-time 15% rebate applied as invoice credit for the first three months, subject to the following conditions:
- Marketing timelines are met (logo+quotes by 12/10, final assets by 1/15)
- Legal addendum with the 12-month publicity license and logo lockup approval is signed
- Finance confirms the credit application flow (Ben, please confirm credit versus cash-back)
- This approval is valid only for the DL-2026-2701 booking and does not set a precedent — flagging the win but not a policy change.

Ben — please confirm the credit mechanics and prepare the addendum with Jonas. Priya — once legal and finance confirm, respond to AltWork with the signed MAP and next steps.

Vivek Kulkarni
